CLI

garage

CLI

The current executable initializes and validates project configuration, records private local events, installs and verifies embedded skills and adopted manuals, and reads issue or pull-request workflow status from GitHub. It does not execute workflows, configure agents, connect providers, or provide a hosted runtime.

./garage --help
